en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Yunus who said ‘I was informed by the one who raised it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>,
regarding the Words of the Mighty and Majestic
[90:11] But he would not attempt the uphill road, [90:12] And what will make you comprehend what the uphill road is? [90:13] (It is) the setting free of a slave.
It Means by Hisazwj Words the setting free of a slave, the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineenasws,
for that is the setting free of a slave’.
